name: Interactive Fiction
description: Play Inform / Z-machine & Glulx text adventures with TTS narration and voice commands.

options.label: Stories folder
options.help: Folder anywhere on this PC that holds your story files (.z5 / .z8 / .zblorb / .ulx / .gblorb). Browse to it; every story inside shows up in the on-screen list. Leave blank to use the app's own bundled stories folder.

options.label: Saves folder
options.help: Folder anywhere on this PC where your save files are written (one subfolder per story). Browse to it. Saves are real files kept outside the app, so they survive app updates and reinstalls. Leave blank to keep them in a 'saves' folder next to your stories.

options.label: Read the story aloud
options.help: Speak each new passage through the system TTS voice (Settings → TTS/STT). Can be toggled on screen at any time.

options.label: Voice commands
options.help: Show the Listen control so you can say commands instead of typing them. Uses the system STT (Settings → TTS/STT).

options.label: Auto-save to file
options.help: Automatically save your progress for the current story every few minutes, so you never lose your place. Saves are written to a 'saves' folder next to your stories. Off by default.

options.label: Auto-save every (minutes)
options.help: How often to auto-save, in minutes. Minimum 1.

options.label: Auto-start story (optional)
options.help: Optional: a story from the stories folder above to open straight into — Browse to it, or type its filename. Only its filename is used, so it must be one of the files in that folder. Leave blank to browse the on-screen list (the normal way).

options.label: TTS host override
options.help: Developer override: a Wyoming TTS host just for this app. Blank uses the system TTS server (Settings → TTS/STT).

options.label: STT host override
options.help: Developer override: a Wyoming STT host just for this app. Blank uses the system STT server (Settings → TTS/STT).
